segments.text:
V. 5.
Moſes hath commanded us to ſtone ſuch—If they ſpoke accurately, this muſt have been a Woman, who having been b•tr••h•d to an H•ſ•and, had been guilty of this Crime before the Marriage was compleated; for ſuch only Moſes commanded to be ſtoned. He commanded indeed, that other Adultereſſes ſhould be put to Death; but the Manner of Death was not ſpecified.
